ideas.pitch: A local C++ code optimization assistant that analyzes competitive programming solutions for time complexity bottlenecks and suggest inline replacements.
ideas.title: OptiC++ Sprint Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Code Red focuses heavily on problem-solving, aptitude, and C++ performance under time pressure. A tool that helps contestants catch sub-optimal loops or memory leaks directly addresses the core spirit of the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight parser and visualizer that renders data structures and pointer movements for C++ code execution in real-time.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace C++ Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since judges value optimal code and problem-solving speed, a live visualization utility for C++ debugging matches the rigorous evaluation criteria of passing all test cases.

ideas.pitch: An automated unit test generator that reads C++ function signatures and generates edge-case stress test suites to ensure zero runtime failures.
ideas.title: TestGen C++ Harness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Contestants lose points for failing edge test cases. Providing an automated harness targeting C++ guarantees higher accuracy during competitive sprints.

ideas.pitch: A localized IDE extension tailored for competitive programmers offering algorithmic hints and time-management telemetry during intense coding sprints.
ideas.title: SpeedCode Timer & Hint Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 'sprinting against the time' rule of the hackathon, prioritizing practical utility for solo developers.

ideas.pitch: A comparative benchmarking tool that profiles C++ solutions against alternative STL implementations to find the absolute lowest execution time.
ideas.title: CP-Benchmark Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the optimization aspect of Code Red, giving solo participants a competitive edge in CPU cycles and memory usage.
